figures.caption: Figure 1: Qualitative Reasoning (Qual.) on a complex multi-panel image. To reach correct conclusions, models must perform (1) panel-level fine-grained perception of morphological features, (2) cross-panel relation understanding, and (3) expert-level reasoning. Current MLLMs struggle with visual trends, leading to hallucinated conclusions compared to human expert analysis.
